prompts.title: Fiery Power Stance
prompts.prompt_text: Dramatic scene of a man standing proudly surrounded by strong flames, his arms emitting flames in gradient colors of red, blue and red, dynamic energy with oversized white t-shirt, camouflage shorts, and black converse shoes, dark background to enhance the contrast of fire and movement, cultural performance feel, high detail, cinematic lighting, and fast shutter photography style

prompts.title: Fire and Ice Submerged Portrait
prompts.prompt_text: Create a high-contrast close-up portrait of the referenced man. The image should depict only the left half of his face, partially submerge in water, with fire and ice droplets and bubbles visible on his skin and hair. Illuminate the left side of the face dramatically, casting the rest into deep shadow. dark background. detail in skin texture beard stubble, and eye focus to evoke a moody cinematic atmosphere. 3:4 orientation. Make it warm color, use my face details from uploaded photo.

prompts.title: 14th August Independence Day Poster
prompts.prompt_text: A vertical Pakistan Independence Day poster design, 14th August theme. A young man with wavy black hair, light beard, wearing a white kurta with a green and white striped scarf/stole draped around his neck, standing confidently, looking at camera with a slight smile. Background shows Minar-e-Pakistan & Qayed Azam mazar monument on the left, a large waving Pakistani flag (dark green with white crescent moon and star, white vertical stripe) on the right side, golden fireworks bursting in the sky, green confetti/paper pieces falling across the frame, warm golden-green cinematic lighting, soft bokeh effect. Top left "14th AUGUST — INDEPENDENCE DAY" in white/gold. Bottom section has decorative Urdu calligraphy line, below it bold text "PROUD TO BE PAKISTANI" in white and green gradient. Portrait/poster style, high detail, professional photo-manipulation, patriotic aesthetic, 9:16 aspect ratio.

prompts.title: Cinematic Golden Light Portrait
prompts.prompt_text: Cinematic close-up portrait of a young man in a white shirt, framed from mid-chest up, occupying most of the frame. His chest and shoulders are angled slightly toward the left side of the frame, while his face is turned toward the right side, looking slightly upward/right, with a calm, thoughtful expression. Messy textured dark hair. Behind him are hanging translucent crinkled cellophane/iridescent metallic foil sheets, creating a shimmering glass-like curtain with vertical folds, reflections and colorful prism highlights. Strong warm golden sunlight passes through the reflective sheets from the right, casting sharp broken leaf-like streaks of golden light and shadow across his face, neck and white shirt, while cool blue light fills the left side. Blue, cyan, purple and amber bokeh in the background, dreamy reflective atmosphere, shallow depth of field, highly detailed cinematic photography, natural skin texture, 4:5 portrait.
